footnotes: Figures are from the company's Form 20-F for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 4.3% to €2.9B in 2025. Gross margin was 77.6%, versus 80.3% a year earlier, and the operating loss widened to €1.4B from €1.3B.
The net loss widened to €1.1B, or −€4.70 per share, from €665M. Operating cash flow was €456M and free cash flow €281M, versus −€78.8M.
sources: BioNTech SE Form 20-F for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
